z.$description:
Layering: a system-wide invariant (what covers what), not geometry. The
family declares the order; the values only have to preserve it. Before this
it was five magic numbers in five files: Menu and Tooltip both sat at 900,
so a tooltip on a menu item resolved by DOM order rather than by design;
Dialog and ConfirmDialog both sat at 1000, and ConfirmDialog opens from a
Dialog, so it worked only by accident of mount order; Toast, the one thing
that must float above everything, declared nothing at all. The order, least
to most interruptible: nav < sheet < dropdown < tooltip < modal <
modal-nested < palette < onboarding < toast.

nav.$description: Fixed page navigation: a bottom bar, a sticky top bar. Arena draws one of these, BottomNav, and the slot is not there for it: it is there because the invariant is system-wide and a consumer's own shell is part of the system, so a host's sticky header and Arena's bar interleave with Arena's overlays by design rather than by DOM order. That was the reason before any component carried it and it is the reason still; what changed is only that the set of things standing on this step is no longer empty. Below dropdown, so a Menu opened from the bar covers it rather than resolving by DOM order, which is the failure this family was created to end. Anything drawn against this slot also reads --pad-safe-bottom, in contracts/design/environment.css, and --layout-bar for its own height

sheet.$description: A non-modal panel anchored to an edge: a cart, a filter drawer, a detail pane that leaves the page usable behind it. Arena draws one of these, Sheet, and the slot exists for the same reason nav does: a host's own edge panel stands beside it on the same step. Above nav, because a sheet that slides over a fixed bar and lands under it is the failure; below dropdown, because a Menu opened from inside the sheet belongs over it. It is NOT modal: a panel that takes the whole interaction is a Dialog, which is two slots higher and has a scrim to say so

dropdown.$description: Menu's panel: a dropdown anchored to its trigger

tooltip.$description: above dropdown, so a tooltip on a menu item wins

modal-nested.$description: ConfirmDialog, which opens from a Dialog

onboarding.$description: the coachmark; the scrim beneath it derives at the point of use as calc(var(--z-onboarding) - 10): one slot, two uses

toast.$description: floats above everything, including onboarding: a transient notice raised by an action taken inside a dialog must stay visible
